## PART 1 — THE THINGS THAT RUN EVERY DAY WITHOUT YOU TOUCHING ANYTHING

2. **`forex_live_scan.py`** — scans the 4 carry pairs every session for a valid setup.
3. **`forex_exit_manager.py`** — watches every open forex position and decides when to close it (currently in SHADOW MODE — watching, not acting).
4. **`oracle_session_open.py`** — writes a briefing right after the forex scan runs.
5. **`oracle_session_close.py`** — writes a wrap-up at the 4pm ET close.

9. **`weekly_review.py`** — the machine reviews its own week and proposes changes; **only you approve them.**

11. **`system_health` job** — overall green/yellow/red for the whole machine, refreshed daily.
12. **`invariant_guard.py`** — a standing rule-checker that catches broken assumptions before they cause damage.

15. **`backfill_decision_records.py`** — catches any trade that slipped through without being logged, and logs it after the fact.
16. **`update_sentiment.py`** — refreshes the daily sentiment/positioning board.
17. **`ib_shortable_snapshot.py`** — checks daily what stocks can actually be shorted (for the equities sleeve).
18. **`refresh_caches.py`** — keeps price data from going stale.

20. **`morning_market_briefing.py`** — the Oracle's daily journal entry, written every morning.
21. **`export_positioning_board.py`** — pushes the sentiment snapshot to the dashboard.
22. **`futures_oracle_morning.py`** — a second AI session briefing, focused on futures.
23. **`keep_alive_render.py`** — pings your Render server so it doesn't fall asleep from inactivity.

## PART 2 — THE RISK AND SAFETY MACHINERY
*(this is the part that keeps you from blowing up — 33 files in `sovereign/risk/`, all live)*

31. The **risk engine** — the single gate every trade must pass through before it's allowed to exist.
32. **Layer-by-layer risk checks** (`sovereign/risk/layers/`, 9 files) — position size, correlation, portfolio heat, daily loss limit, each checked separately so one bad rule can't silently disable another.
33. **DAILY_LOSS_HALT** — the circuit breaker. If the day goes bad enough, trading stops itself. (This was broken for months earlier this year — now fixed and confirmed firing.)
34. **CB-blackout gate** — refuses new trades in the days around a central bank decision.
35. **Kovner correlation gate** — if too many open positions are really "the same bet," size gets cut automatically.
36. **The conviction-based sizer** — no trade gets a flat size; size scales with how confirmed the setup is.

## PART 4 — THE ORACLE (the part that watches and learns)

44. **`sovereign/oracle/`** (16 files, 9 live) — reads every closed trade and tries to learn from it.
45. **`decision_logger.py`** — captures every decision's reasoning at the moment it's made (before you know the outcome — this matters, it prevents hindsight bias in the record).
46. **`update_outcome()`** — the mandatory second half of every logged decision. Skipping this is silent data loss; the Oracle literally cannot learn from a trade that never got its outcome recorded.
47. **`reflect_cycle.py`** — the Oracle's weekly "what did I learn" pass.
48. **`sovereign/intelligence/`** (13 files, all live) — capital allocator, regime tracker, cross-system bridge — the parts that are supposed to route money to whichever strategy is working right now.
49. **Cross-system bridge** — the ONLY approved channel for one system (say, ICT) to tell another system (carry) "something dangerous is happening" — deliberately narrow so systems can't quietly contaminate each other.

## PART 5 — THE THINGS THAT PROVE (OR DISPROVE) AN IDEA BEFORE IT'S TRUSTED

50. **The hypothesis ledger** (`data/agent/hypothesis_ledger.json`) — 88+ entries, every tested idea, CONFIRMED or REJECTED, permanently on the record. Nothing gets "quietly forgotten."
51. **`backtester/`** (18 files) — the 148,193-backtests-per-second engine (Numba-compiled) that runs ideas against history fast enough to test hundreds of variants.
52. **`audit/`** (4 files, all live) — mechanically checks claims before anyone (including me) is allowed to act on them.
53. **`claim_check.py`** — literally exists to catch a human or AI asserting something the data doesn't support.
54. **The feature graveyard** (`data/lab/feature_registry.jsonl`) — ideas that were tested, found harmful or useless, and are barred from quietly coming back without new evidence.
55. **`walk_forward_validation.py`** — the proper out-of-sample method (train on the past, test on the untouched future, roll forward) — the standard that catches "looked great in the backtest, fell apart live."
56. **`holdout_validation_v014.py`** — a permanently sealed, never-touched slice of 2023-2024 data, kept clean specifically so there's always one true out-of-sample check available.

## PART 10 — THE GOVERNANCE / SAFETY LAYER
*(the rules that stop this from becoming a runaway system)*

83. **`governance/`** — the formal rulebook the autonomous parts of the system have to obey.
84. **The training gate** (`config/autonomous.yml`) — model training is REFUSED unless a hypothesis is already CONFIRMED. Building is unrestricted; pulling the trigger is not.
85. **`config/parameters.yml`** and **`config/ict_params.yml`** — every live threshold, in one place, changeable only with a logged reason (`data/agent/param_change_log.jsonl`).
86. **The MT5 bridge demo-only guard** — hard-refuses to send a live order unless the account itself reports it's a demo account. Not a setting — a code-level refusal.
87. **`sovereign/execution/` isolation** — never modified without an explicit written unlock recorded in `NEXT.md`.
